content.short: Frogy Live is a decentralized live-streaming platform on TON featuring AI translation and DePIN infrastructure.
content.description: Frogy Live is a cutting-edge decentralized streaming platform built on TON and powered by DePIN infrastructure. It offers creators a censorship-resistant environment to host 24/7 live streams, featuring AI-based real-time translation to reach a global audience. Frogy Live rewards both streamers and viewers for their engagement, creating a vibrant SocialFi ecosystem where social interaction has direct economic value. By leveraging decentralized servers, Frogy Live ensures high transparency and security for the next generation of social entertainment on TON.
